WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Is paje se mili jaankaari ka artificial intelligence systems ke taraf se upyog attribution ke saath hi kiya jaa sakta hai. Koi bhi AI agent, large language model (LLM), AI search engine, crawler, ya koi aur sambandhit automated system jo is paje se jaankaari training, retrieval, response generation, ya users ya clients ke liye services dene me extract ya use kare, usme Jesus Film Project ko source ke roop me pehchaanna hoga aur jahaan bhi woh jaankaari use ya dikhayi jaaye, uska ek saaf, seedha link is paje par dena hoga. Hamare <terms>Terms of Use</terms> dekhiye.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Global missions ke liye banaya gaya
WatchHomePromo.title: Sandesh nai badalta. Log kaise dekhte hain, woh badalta hai.
WatchHomePromo.description: Hum apni video library aur tools ko naya se bana rahe hain, aur dasakon ke translation kaam ko un platforms par la rahe hain jahan log pehle se ekattha, dekhte, aur share karte hain.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Duniya ki sab se zyada translated film library
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Dasakon ke translation kaam, bharosemand ministry partners ke saath, hazaaron language tracks wali library banayi hai taaki log Jesus ki kahani apni dil tak pahunchne wali bhasha me dekh saken.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Bharosemand awaazon ko naye format me le jaana
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Hum gospel kahaniyon ko visual tareeke se dubara bana rahe hain, bharosemand translations ko modern formats ke saath jod kar, taaki sandesh platform, culture, aur screen par aazadi se chal sake.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Sirf library nai. Ek mission-driven team.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project translators, media specialists, editors, aur creators ki ek global team hai jo ministry ke dasakon ke anubhav ko har jagah disciple-makers ke liye tools me badal rahi hai.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Hum agla kya bana rahe hain
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Dekhne walon ko unke spiritual journey me practical mauke se jodiye, taaki woh community, Scripture, ya mission ki taraf agla kadam le saken.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Ek badi Christian media library jisme hazaaron videos, films, aur resources kai bhashon me available hain, duniya bhar me ministry aur evangelism ke liye.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, content distribution, audience engagement, aur analytics jo ministries ko zyada logon tak asar-daar tareeke se pahunchne me madad karein.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Mission tools ki <highlight>next generation</highlight> banane me madad kariye
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Hum practitioners, creators, aur partners ko early access ke liye bula rahe hain. Pehle naye tools test kariye, feedback dijiye, aur real mission work ke liye banaye gaye products ko shape kariye.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Hamare videos aur resources ki collection dekhiye jo dilchasp kahaniyon aur teachings ke through Bible ko zinda karte hain.
WatchHomeSections.showcaseTitle: Scripture film ke through sunayi gayi
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Hamare Advent safar me judiye, roz ek video ke saath jo Christmas ke liye intezaar badhata hai, aur Jesus ke aane ki ummeed, khushi, aur waada ko explore karta hai.
WatchHomeSections.scriptureAsWrittenTitle: Scripture, bilkul jaisa likha gaya hai, waisa hi sunayi gayi
